title: Complete source and topology lifecycle in the common tick
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Integrate emitters, removals, destroyers, phase transfer and topology/kinematic changes with the sole staged tick boundary across completed domain and coupling bindings. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Sources are admitted before the single index publication; rejected proposals remain observable, and phase transfers discovered in solve apply atomically at the next boundary.
Destination admission failure preserves source mass/identity; no source-specific rebuild, duplicate advance, missing IDs or dropped pending inputs.
Exercise spawn/outflow, reset, replacement, topology edits, teleports within the envelope and capacity recovery through public native execution on an applicable GPU.
Independent mass/thermal and generation-lifetime checks plus cold/sustained mixed-family runs pass with fixed workload counts and no extra iterations.
